subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 11: Get ready for A1 Movers & Fun corner
outcomes: Choose the best answer in a short dialogue.
Say which picture is different and why.
Write a healthy shopping list and ask for food politely.

tf.s: A shopping list tells you what to buy.
tf.why: Yes! You write the things you want to buy.

tf.s: 'Is there any water?' 'Yes, there are.' is correct.
A good exam tip is to read each option and say it in your head.
tf.why: Great tip! It helps you choose the best answer.
Crisps aren't very healthy. Fruit and vegetables are healthy.

tf.s: A cupcake is very healthy because it's sweet.
tf.why: A cupcake is sweet, so it isn't very healthy.

tf.s: You pay at the checkout in a shop.
tf.why: Correct! The checkout is where you pay.

tf.s: Vegetables are good for a healthy shopping list.
We use 'because' to say why a picture is different.
Dad asks Zaid to go to school.
tf.why: Dad asks Zaid to go to the shops.

tf.s: In the board game, you ask 'Can I have ..., please?'

boxes.q: Dad: Can you go to the shops for me? Zaid: ...
Dad: Do we need anything else? Zaid: ...
Dad: Great, thanks Zaid! Bye! Zaid: ...

o: Can I have a bottle of water, please?

boxes.q: The shopkeeper gives you food. He says...
boxes.why: We say 'Here you are' when we give something.
Bottles are for drinks like water.

boxes.q: Which word means 'good for your body'?
boxes.why: Healthy food is good for your body.

mcq.q: Dad: Is there any milk? Zaid: ...
Dad: Are there any eggs? Zaid: ...
Where does Dad want Zaid to go?
mcq.why: Dad asks: Can you go to the shops for me?

mcq.q: What should you do with each answer option in the exam?
o: Read it and say it in your head.
mcq.why: Reading each option helps you choose.

mcq.q: Which shopping list is the most healthy?
mcq.why: Fruit, vegetables, water and fish are healthy.

mcq.q: You want two apples in the game. What do you say?
o: Can I have two apples, please?

mcq.q: Picture A has three apples. Picture B has two apples. Which sentence is right?
o: In Picture A there are three apples.
In Picture A there is three apples.
In Picture B there are three apples.
In Picture A there are two apples.
mcq.why: Picture A has three apples: 'there are three apples'.

mcq.q: Which is different: apple, banana, orange, carrot?
mcq.why: Apple, banana and orange are fruit; a carrot is a vegetable.

mcq.q: Why is 'a bottle of cheese' wrong?
o: We don't put cheese in a bottle.
mcq.why: Bottles are for drinks like water.

mcq.q: Why is fruit better than a cupcake for a healthy list?
o: A cupcake is sweet, but fruit is healthy.
mcq.why: Sweet food is not very healthy.
